name: Arcturus Exo-Runner Frame
description: A lower-body exoskeleton that augments running speed and endurance. Originally military — allowing soldiers to maintain 40 km/h on foot for hours — the Exo-Runner has found its way onto the civilian market as a high-end personal transport alternative. Strap it on over your clothes, lock the hip and knee joints, and run like a machine. Popular with couriers, security patrols, and athletes. The learning curve involves falling at speed, repeatedly.
propulsion: Electric servo-assisted hydraulic joints, battery pack at lower back
armament: None standard. The kicks are devastating.
common_usage: Long-range couriers, security patrols, athletic training, military logistics.
story_hooks: An Exo-Runner's gait AI starts optimizing for terrain the wearer hasn't encountered yet — as if it knows where they're going before they do
A black market in stolen military Exo-Runners supplies a courier network that can outrun any ground vehicle in the city
